items.title: Chester Zardis Interview, 1966-03-09
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] This is Bill Russell speaking... We're going to interview Chester Zardas this morning.

ctx.x: This is Bill Russell speaking at 732 St. Peter Street. We're going to interview Chester Zardas this morning. Can you give your full name? Do you have a middle name?
My name is Chester Zardas and born in 1900. What was the exact date? It's May the 27th, 1900. May the 27th.
